item.description:
Features

  • Icon-only menu bar mode now shows a small play icon while video playback is detected, so you can tell at a glance why breaks are paused, even with text hidden.
  • Smart Breaks: after being away for a while (sleep/idle), your break cycle now resets too. So you won't get hit with a long break right after returning, since being away already served as your rest.

Bugfixes

  • Break windows now follow you when you switch virtual desktops (Spaces) during a break, instead of staying behind on the desktop where the break started.
